description: This file defines the 'Event' controller class within the OpenCart admin marketplace module. It manages event listing, filtering, enabling, disabling, and deletion functionalities, including generating URLs, loading language resources, models, and view templates.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace events in the OpenCart admin panel, providing listing, filtering, bulk status change, and delete operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the event list view, sets up breadcrumbs, and page headers.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to return the event list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered, paginated list of events from the model and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected events by updating their status via the model, with permission check.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected events by updating their status via the model, with permission check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected events via the model, with permission validation.
